task: Fix chat UI bug where the "Processed in" duration/timestamp metadata is not rendered immediately for interactive-only assistant responses (checkbox/submit follow-ups) and only appears after a page refresh.

key_reasoning.reason: Fix lands in the shared NDJSON streaming finalize path (chatGeneration._handleStreamResponse, _handleChunk), which has zero test coverage today - no assertion anywhere for processingTime, the metadata row, or the responseTime -> processingTime mapping. Two plausible root-cause mechanisms exist (the conditional processingTime assignment AND the if/else-if chain that swallows a terminal chunk carrying both interactive_request and last:true), so fixing only one may leave the bug reproducible for a different chunk shape. An undocumented contract question remains: client-measured (endTime-startTime)/1000 vs the server-persisted responseTime shown after refresh may visibly disagree. Mitigated by sibling paths (_handleNonStreamResponse, finalizeFailedRequest) that already set the duration unconditionally - the change is an alignment, not a new design.

Primary change site is chatGeneration store finalize, with an optional adjacent fix to the numeric truthiness guard in ChatAiMessage.tsx ({processingTime && ...} also hides a legitimate 0, and component-patterns.md forbids && on a numeric operand). The finalize path is shared by every chat turn, not just interactive ones, so the blast radius covers all assistant responses - hence AC #5's no-regression clause for message rendering, tool call display, and action buttons.

Ticket carries explicit steps to reproduce and five concrete acceptance criteria, and the root cause is confirmed. Two open decisions remain: whether the displayed duration should stay client-measured or be sourced from the backend responseTime (api-integration.md requires reading the backend handler before assuming the semantic contract - not yet done, and the analysis covered only the frontend repo), and whether the adjacent falsy-0 guard is in scope for AC #2 consistency.

Production diff is small (1-2 files, roughly 5-20 lines: src/store/chatGeneration.ts, optionally ChatAiMessage.tsx). Effort is dominated by test work spanning three directories: extend src/store/__tests__/chatGeneration.interactive.test.ts, add metadata-row coverage under ChatAiMessage/__tests__, and create the repo's first chat integration test (src/pages/chat/__tests__/ChatPage.integration.test.tsx) - unit tests globally stub valtio useSnapshot, so the live re-render failure mode is structurally unprovable at unit level.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): the defect and its fix sit inside the streaming chunk-handling pipeline (custom NDJSON reader loop, _handleChunk merge semantics, stream finalize), with no streaming guide and no chunk-level parsing tests in the repo.

Component Scope bumped from S (2) to M (3): touches a core shared code path - _handleStreamResponse finalizes every chat turn, not only interactive-only follow-ups, so the change carries regression risk across all assistant responses.
